text:
Maya (AE): Quick one — Solara sent back an order form asking for a 120k token/month POC credit for 3 months and wants DocuSign to trigger services; procurement says PO will arrive within 10 days. Finance insists on PO before billing. Can we bridge?
Rohit (SE): We can enable a sandbox on signature but restrict production features until PO. BYOK is OK but call out feature limits (cache snapshots, warm starts). I'll draft a 1-page tech note.
Jen (Sales Ops): Ops proposal: prepare DocuSign envelope with placeholder PO field and a contingency clause: "Services are contingent on receipt of an authorized purchase order; Provider may suspend billable services if PO not received within 14 days of countersignature." That lets them sign now.
Adele (Legal): We prefer POC addendum instead of changing MSA. Addendum should state POC term, SLA (kept at 99.9% unless customer accepts temporary 99.5%), liability cap = fees paid during POC, BYOK appendix, and the PO contingency language.
Maya (AE): Customer redline: "120,000 token credits/mo for months 1-3; Services begin on countersignature; PO to follow within 10 days; overage billed at 50% list while credits remain."
Rohit (SE): 50% list for overage during POC is reasonable. Need to define token meter (per UTC-month) in order form.
Jen (Sales Ops): DocuSign template ord-poc-v1 supports parallel signing and addenda attachment. I'll prep envelope and set routing: customer legal + procurement parallel -> customer eng -> provider AE -> provider finance.
contract-bot: Template note: ord-poc-v1 fields: po_number, credit_amount, overage_rate. Draft envelope id: env-90311.
Adele (Legal): I'll upload the addendum draft to shared drive and send final wording in 90 minutes. Include the PO contingency and liability cap.
Maya (AE): I'll nudge customer for PO upload ASAP. If PO not in 14 days, we'll suspend billable services per clause. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
